faq_1.question: How long does delivery take in Egypt?
faq_1.answer: 2–5 business days nationwide. Cairo and Giza often receive same-week delivery.

faq_2.question: How much is shipping?
faq_2.answer: Shipping is free on every order inside Egypt. Add 2 pieces to get 10% off, or 3 pieces or more to get 20% off.

faq_3.question: Are RUQYA designs printed or woven?
faq_3.answer: All designs are woven directly into the fabric — never printed or replicated.

faq_4.question: What is your return policy?
faq_4.answer: Returns accepted within 14 days if unworn with tags attached.

faq_5.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_5.answer: Cash on delivery. Pay the courier in cash or via InstaPay when your order arrives.
